name: talaria-v0-2-block-markdown
description: v0.2 block-level markdown + transcript differentiation (plan revision 2, post doc-review): ADR-first bounded-rendering claim (four ceilings, descendant-counted), domain terminal-path commits under a typed cause with exact content preservation, safe parser+rendering boundary, hybrid pane with two live tails, kind channels, restated two-part gate proof with a sideband timeline, re-run green. Every build unit is cross-reviewed by the Codex engine before its dependents run, and dependents consume the review VERDICT, not its completion: a review returning findings blocks its dependents until the findings are fixed and re-reviewed. units.label: ADR-0006: the block-aware bounded-rendering claim
units.prompt: U1: Write ADR-0006 recording the block-aware bounded-rendering claim BEFORE any widget work: the FOUR ceilings of KTD1 with their exact measurement points - (a) TWO-TIER descendant count (a table mounts one widget per cell, so top-level blocks bound nothing): the folded window (everything except the newest entry and live tails) <= 600 descendants, AND a TWO-CONDITION per-entry trigger on the newest entry and each tail - descendants (or the CONSTRUCT-AWARE estimate: top-level tokens PLUS table cells rows*columns from the delimiter row, because a probed 3-line 601-column table mounts 1,204 descendants) > 1,200, OR ESTIMATED WRAPPED ROWS > mount_cap (500) where estimated wrapped rows = sum over source lines of max(1, ceil(cell_len(line)/content_width)) using DISPLAY-CELL width (Textual's cell-length measure, NEVER len(): a probed 37,000-char double-width CJK line paints 949 rows where len() estimates 475) - a probed single 100,000-char source line is ONE descendant rendering 1,353 rows and a 10,000-line open fence is ONE block with two descendants at 10,004 rows, so neither a descendant nor a source-line condition sees them. THE FALLBACK RENDERS NON-WRAPPING, one widget per projected line with wrap OFF: the widget paints one row and clips at the viewport edge, a banner note marks the clip, and the full line stays in the terminal-read buffer (the screen clips, the buffer doesn't). Wrapping was rejected twice over, both probed: one wrapping fallback widget paints 1,283 rows; pre-split hard-wrap fragments make a 100,000-char line ~1,283 widgets (its own cap violation), break the rendered_lines reconstruction, force fragment-aware condensation, and re-wrap on every resize. Non-wrapping keeps painted rows == widgets == projected lines FOR THE ENTRY'S CONTENT; each fallen-back entry additionally mounts ONE separately budgeted banner widget/row, so the exact-row formula is painted rows == projected lines + 1 banner row per fallen-back entry. Banner rows are CHARGED TO THE FOLD ARITHMETIC, never to a fixed headroom: a fallen-back entry's accounted row span is projected lines + 1, the fold rule counts accounted rows against mount_cap (500), and the 500-to-600 margin pays only FIXED-COUNT chrome (the single condensation banner) - a per-entry cost against a fixed margin is unbounded (302 one-line fallen-back entries put 301 two-widget entries, 602 widgets, into a folded window whose 301 projected lines never trigger a lines-only fold; charging the banner row folds that shape at 500 accounted rows, <= 501 widgets, inside the 600 ceiling); banner rows are chrome, not content - they never enter the condensed_count + lines-accounted-for == total identity. The 500-accounted-row cap plus at most one condensation-banner widget bounds height, and resize moves only the clip point. The construct-aware estimate counts top-level tokens plus table cells plus per-construct container widgets, calibrated against the installed widget's actual mounting and pinned by a test - beyond which THAT ENTRY ALONE falls back to line rendering with a banner note; a line-rendered entry folds under today's line cap (desired_top may land inside it; for a fallen-back entry the cut folds content rows only - a partially retained entry keeps exactly one banner, painted rows = retained projected lines + 1, and a cut retaining zero content rows rounds FORWARD to fold the whole entry, banner included: a banner never stands alone), so the fallback can never exceed the line machinery's own bounds - observed at every 50ms coalescing boundary via Textual's own tree, with the recorded reason why 'every instant' is not the enforcement point (Markdown.update parses off the pump and mounts in batches of 200, transiently holding old and new blocks); (b) rendered height bounded by the same two tiers; (c) reconcile work measured as PARSER-INPUT BYTES per boundary (the reparse window from the last unfinished top-level block - probed: constant 500-byte appends into an open fence produce growing parser inputs 499/999/1,499/..., so bytes-handed-to-append understates work), proportional to unfinished block + new bytes with the latency ceiling as the enforceable bound and the per-entry fallback as the relief valve; (d) p99 apply latency under 50ms on the exact workloads (unclosed fence fed 100 lines/boundary to 10,000 lines; table fed 10 rows/boundary to 1,000 rows; a single unbroken line grown 5,000 chars/boundary to 100,000 chars; time.monotonic around TranscriptPane.apply; first 10 boundaries warm-up-excluded). Amend ADR-0005 decision 3 (the 500-line-widget 'at every instant' cap): 500 stays DEFAULT_MOUNT_CAP - the line cap for line-rendered surfaces and the wrapped-rows trigger threshold - while 600 is the folded-window descendant ceiling the gate enforces; state the two-tier model in those terms AND decision 7 (literal_text-only - untrusted text may additionally reach the screen through the KTD4-configured parser and rendering hooks and nothing else). Record requirements amendments RA1 (underscore emphasis + strikethrough in scope), RA2 (R3 met by cell wrapping, not cell focus), and RA3 (on FALLEN-BACK entries only, R11's projection-to-screen visibility and R3's legibility narrow to one painted row per projected line plus a banner naming the clip and cause; the gate proves banner + exact row count, not clipped-cell reachability; the expand affordance is queued follow-up, not built) and the KTD8 fallback trigger with its branch-hold mechanism. Mirror to docs/engineering-journal/DECISIONS.md. Read docs/plans/2026-08-09-talaria-v0-2-block-markdown-plan.md (unit U1, KTD1/KTD8, RA1/RA2/RA3, R13) as your authoritative spec.

(4) The reasoning weld stays decoration on line-rendered surfaces only; the flattened decorated line buffer stays byte-identical for terminal_read and content_is_complete - tests/domain/test_projection.py::test_every_transcript_entry_survives_into_the_line_buffer must pass UNMODIFIED. units.label: The block factory and its forgery proof
units.prompt: U3: Create talaria/ui/blocks.py - the single constructor for safely configured Markdown entry documents. Parser side: parser_factory returning MarkdownIt('gfm-like') with html=False and linkify=False, open_links=False, defang before parse at parity with talaria/ui/literal.py, and an ALLOWLIST PIN: a snapshot test of the parser's exact enabled rule set (RA1's underscore emphasis and strikethrough are in it; any preset drift or new rule fails the pin). Rendering side (the parser config is NOT the whole boundary): Textual installs @click action metadata for links unconditionally (_markdown.py:342) and emits Markdown.LinkClicked regardless of open_links (:1194), and renders images as alt text with the target dropped (:346) - so the factory's document subclass renders links styled but with NO action metadata (test: clicking emits no LinkClicked and opens/fetches nothing) and renders images as 'alt (target)' text per R10. Prove every forbidden channel: HTML literalized visible (never dropped), Rich console markup unparsed, ANSI defanged, bare URLs stay text, entry isolation across an unclosed fence (R15), and the Textual 8.2.8 pin test - append reparses from the last unfinished block, update replaces, and the public Markdown.get_stream (:1155) exists (the corrected KTD3 evidence) - failing loudly on upgrade drift. R4 scope note: configuration and subclassed rendering hooks only; no parser or block-assembly engine. units.label: The hybrid transcript pane
units.prompt: U4: Rebuild TranscriptPane as the hybrid, committing to the feat/v0-2-block-markdown-build branch (KTD8 branch-hold). Committed assistant/reasoning entries mount one Markdown document each (built by talaria/ui/blocks.py), every other kind keeps one TranscriptLine per line, and the in-flight streams render in TWO independently keyed live tail documents (assistant and reasoning can stream in the same turn - R18) driven by public Markdown.append at the 50ms boundary using the projection's stream generation: same generation appends the suffix beyond what was last applied, changed generation calls update() with the authoritative text - NEVER a prefix guess. Commit hands each tail's source to its entry document keyed by entry id, no pane rebuild. Restate rendered_lines as a content reconstruction (line widgets contribute their line; block entries contribute their projected source lines via line spans) so pane.rendered_lines == view.lines[condensed_count:] stays true, and update the three existing suites that assert it IN PLACE (tests/ui/test_markdown.py:297, tests/transport/test_session_startup.py:607, tests/transport/test_source_equivalence.py:277+299) - never delete them. Condensation over mixed units: desired_top computed in ACCOUNTED ROWS (projected lines + 1 banner row per fallen-back entry - banner rows count toward the cap and stay out of the condensed-line identity; a cut inside a fallen-back entry folds content rows only: a partially retained entry keeps exactly one banner - painted rows = retained projected lines + 1 - and a cut retaining zero content rows rounds FORWARD to fold the whole entry, banner included, so a banner never stands alone), rounds UP to the next unit boundary; a BLOCK-RENDERED newest entry is mounted whole with overage recorded, while a fallen-back LINE-RENDERED newest entry folds under the cap like any line content (KTD2's rule); banner line arithmetic still sums. Enforce KTD1(a)'s TWO-TIER ceilings at every coalescing boundary: folded window <= 600 descendants; newest entry and each tail under the TWO-CONDITION trigger (descendants/construct-aware-estimate > 1,200 - the estimate counts table cells, a 3-line 601-column table mounts 1,204 descendants - OR estimated wrapped rows > mount_cap 500 in DISPLAY CELLS - sum of max(1, ceil(cell_len(line)/content_width)), never len() (probed: 37,000 double-width chars paint 949 rows, len() says 475): the 10,000-line fence and the 100,000-char line at 1,353 rows are only visible to the wrapped-rows condition). The fallback renders NON-WRAPPING, one widget per projected line with wrap off (paints one row, clips at the viewport, banner note marks the clip per RA3 - the banner is ONE separately budgeted widget/row per fallen-back entry CHARGED TO THE FOLD ARITHMETIC (accounted row span = projected lines + 1; the fixed 500-to-600 margin pays only the single condensation banner, never a per-entry cost), so painted rows == projected lines + 1 banner row, pinned; the gate proves banner + exact row count, not clipped-cell reachability; the full line stays in the terminal-read buffer) - a probed single WRAPPING fallback widget paints 1,283 rows and pre-split fragments are their own cap violation, both forbidden; fixtures: the mega-line (one content row plus one banner row - two widgets - at every width, anchor held through resize), the double-width line, the 601-column table, the EXACT-BOUNDARY regression (a 599-column table plus one paragraph: blocks+cells estimate exactly 1,200, the installed widget mounts 1,201 - the calibrated estimate must exceed 1,200 and fire), and the AGGREGATE-CEILING regression (302 one-line fallen-back entries - 301 in the folded tier at two accounted rows each, 602 total: a lines-only fold would mount 602 widgets under the 600 ceiling; the fold must fire on accounted rows and hold <= 500 accounted rows / <= 600 descendants), and the ODD-CUT regression (250 one-line fallen-back entries plus one ordinary line = 501 accounted rows, desired_top = 1 inside the oldest entry's two-row span: the fold rounds forward and takes the whole entry banner included - never a bannerless clipped row, never an orphan banner - and the arithmetic still sums), beyond which THAT entry alone line-renders with a banner note and folds under today's line cap like any line content (the fallback also ends the growing reparse of an ever-open block). ZERO-BLOCK sources (empty/whitespace-only/newline-only - they mount height-zero documents, probed) never take the block path: they line-render, preserving blank rows as visible line widgets. R16 clauses 2-3: a terminal path stops and awaits pending widget writes; a stale stream write after its widget was condensed away or removed updates nothing and raises nothing. Retire the inline styler from the live path (MARKDOWN_KINDS moves to blocks; talaria/ui/markdown.py is retained as the KTD8 fallback's styling half with a comment saying why; its pane-level assertions move to the reconstruction). Per-construct render oracles: heading, bullet list, ordered list, block quote, fence, table each asserted by block class and geometry and each proven to fail when flattened (R1). Tables per RA2's exact column arithmetic (wrapping alone starves columns under grid-columns:auto, probed [0,0,58,1,1] at 80 cols): for N columns in the table's ACTUAL INNER content width W (the Markdown document pads two columns each side - probed: 80-col pane gives MarkdownTableContent 76 - so measure W from the table content box or explicitly remove the padding and pin the choice), available A = W - (3N + 1), proportional remainders by largest-remainder method with ties to the leftmost column; CAP = max(8, floor(A/N)); m_i = min(longest_word_i, CAP); if sum(m_i) <= A give each column m_i plus proportional remainder, else give every column floor(A/N) with a hard floor of 3 and character-wrap longer words; the factory's table subclass sets these widths explicitly. Assert the ACTUAL PAINTED CONTENT of every cell at 80 columns, the five-column probe case included. Reader anchor and follow-bottom survive reinterpretation, resize, condensation (R17). Read docs/plans/2026-08-09-talaria-v0-2-block-markdown-plan.md (unit U4, KTD1/KTD2/KTD3, RA2, R1/R2/R3/R5/R16/R17/R18) as your authoritative spec.
